Description
100 Gram Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse Cast is a 99.99% purity which is manufactured by the world’s leading precious refiner
PAMP Suisse
. The PAMP Suisse 100 Gram Cast Gold Bars are classic hand-poured, loaf style gold bars making them unique.
The 100 Gram Cast Gold bars are produced by pouring molten gold into a mold and once the gold is soft, the engraving is imprinted on the bar. The resulting blemished and abnormalities of the casting give each bar character, as well a desirable rustic appearance. Although the casting process doesn’t produce finely finished edges and shapes like mint gold bars, gold bars that are produced using cast technology are highly desired due to the rarity of these bars.
Every 100 Gram Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse Cast is unique with an assay mark imprinted on it, moreover, the assay card that comes along with the gold bar allows you to verify the authenticity of the purchase.
100 Gram PAMP Suisse Cast Gold Bar can be suitable for investors as they are available at a cheaper premium, easy to liquidate, and comes with an individually serialized number along with an original assay certificate.
Design of 100 Gram Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse Cast
The PAMP Suisse 100 Gram Cast Gold Bar features the PAMP Suisse logo  – consisting of the letters “PAMP” enclosed by 4 small circular tubes inside a large circle. This is followed by the word “Sussie” under which the purity, weight, and a serial number of the bar are engraved.
The rough and raw texture of the PAMP Suisse 100 Gram Gold Bar accentuates the aesthetic aspect of the bar, giving it a natural and archaic character that is valuable to collectors all over the world.
Main Highlights of PAMP Suisse 100 Gram Cast Gold Bar
Contains 100 gram(3.215 oz) of .9999 fine gold.
Manufactured by PAMP Suisse.
Eligible for
Precious Metal IRAs
.
The individual bar comes with an assay card that guarantees the weight, purity, and metal content of a gold bar.
The obverse features the depiction of the PAMP Suisse logo along with purity, weight, assay stamp, and a serial number.
The reverse is left blank.
